newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures end lower across the board.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures end lower across the board.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures closed weaker across the board on Friday, reflecting losses in the Chicago market on Thursday, traders said.
Prices were 210 to 280 yen lower, with the benchmark July 1998 contract down 240 yen at 13,750 yen per tonne.
The day's estimated volume was 79,394 lots.
"Light technical buying emerged by late afternoon," a brokerage house trader said. But active selling capped the topside, as bearish sentiment remained following losses on Thursday, traders said.
The spot July corn contract on the CBOT Project A overnight trading system stood at $2.65 per bushel at 0730 GMT, against $2.65-1/4 at Thursday's close.
Spot July CBOT soybean futures were trading at $8.40-1/2 a bushel at 0730 GMT, against $8.38 at Thursday's close.
